title: 部活動の場面
lead: バレーボール・バスケットボール・吹奏楽・美術部など、中高生の部活動の場面12点です。学校案内や部員募集のポスターに使えます。
subject_en: Flat illustration of Japanese junior-high or high-school club activities, each ONE student or two students in action, full body, centred, natural friendly faces, varied genders. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a student jumping to spike a volleyball
a student painting at an easel
a student kicking a soccer ball
a student in kendo gear raising a shinai
a student whisking tea in a tatami room
a student speaking into a microphone
a student looking at a flask
